2. Mathematical specification:
The optimization problem is:
  minimize max_k ∫_0^2 h(x)(1-h(x+k)) dx
subject to:
  0 ≤ h(x) ≤ 1 for all x
  ∫_0^2 h(x) dx = 1

Discretization uses n equally spaced points and dx=2/n. The solution is verified using:
  CPU timer monitoring
  Careful constraint preservation
  FFT-based correlation calculation for larger n
